prompt: Create a centered, high-end 3D render of a single translucent glass orb on a pure white studio background. The orb is a perfectly smooth sphere made of thick glossy crystal, with a dark smoky interior and layered, flowing ribbon-like waves suspended inside it. The internal ribbons curve horizontally in elegant S-shaped bands: electric cyan and deep blue across the upper half, molten gold and orange through the middle, hot magenta and violet through the lower half. Add bright neon light streaks, tiny star-like glints, and caustic refractions following the curves, as if glowing energy is trapped inside the glass. Use transparent glossy crystal glass, electric blue, cyan, gold, orange, magenta, violet, and pure white. Include large soft white specular highlights near the upper left and upper right of the sphere, a crisp luminous rim around the edge, subtle internal reflections, and a soft blurred colored shadow underneath in blue, purple, and pink. The composition should be minimal and product-shot-like, with the sphere occupying most of the square frame, no text, no logos, no extra objects, ultra-detailed, polished, futuristic, luminous, photorealistic, octane-render style.
